title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: When you do your minor league signings, you should do your follow up tweets in response to your original. The algorithm on Twitter fucks things up, so something a players random BR page shows up but your original tweet doesn’t
I don’t even know if I should do my follow up tweets, they’re dumb
People are lazy, so if you provide them context without making them leave twitter to look it up, it’ll be worth it
So I can follow up without it saying “@anthonyfenech” first
Never done a thread, actually. I get real stubborn with social media
yup, works on the app too
